home_faq_subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about MetaCleaner.
home_faq_1_question: Are my files safe? Are they uploaded to a server?
home_faq_1_answer: No. MetaCleaner processes all files exclusively locally on your device. No file or metadata is ever sent to our servers. Your data stays 100% with you.
home_faq_2_answer: MetaCleaner removes all types of EXIF metadata, including GPS coordinates, device information, date and time fields, and other hidden fields that may be a source of disclosure.
home_faq_3_answer: MetaCleaner supports processing all types of images and documents, including JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, PDF, and other common formats. All files are processed locally and without loss of quality.
home_faq_4_question: Is it possible to create custom metadata or a sharing method?
home_faq_4_answer: No. MetaCleaner is designed for secure file sharing, not for creating custom metadata or sharing. All files are processed locally and no metadata is created.
home_faq_5_question: Is it possible to process files larger than 100 MB?
home_faq_5_answer: Yes, MetaCleaner supports processing files larger than 100 MB. All files are processed locally and without loss of quality, up to the maximum size allowed by your device.
home_faq_6_answer: Basic features are free. For advanced features like batch processing, we offer a premium plan.
home_faq_7_answer: The mobile app works fully offline. The web version requires a connection only to load the page.
home_faq_8_answer: No. We only remove metadata, the image itself remains unchanged in full quality.
